title: vLLM extension boundaries and correctness gates
summary: Scope scheduler, attention, quantization or connector changes to their owner and preserve sampling, cancellation, lifetime and distributed contracts.

zh-CN.title: vLLM 扩展边界与正确性门槛
zh-CN.summary: 按职责定位调度器、注意力、量化和连接器改动，保持采样、取消、生命周期及分布式契约。

conditions: Write the trigger, current/desired behavior, affected owners and allowed numerical differences.
Verify the requested behavior is not already available through the resolved configuration.

recommendations: Make the smallest change at the responsible owner and preserve supported fallback semantics.
For speculation preserve accepted/recovered/bonus tokens, termination and rollback; for connectors preserve completion and allocation ownership.
validation_plan: Run focused native unit tests, device correctness, concurrency/abort and distributed failure tests relevant to the change.
Test target distributions as well as greedy outputs, then perform a bounded service comparison under frozen gates.
limitations: Greedy equality alone does not validate stochastic speculative decoding.
Native inference tests depend on repository fixtures and compatible dependencies; bypassing conftest is not engine validation.
This indexed abstract links to the complete bilingual skill and source evidence; it is imported guidance, not a benchmark result.
Accelerator execution, real-model quality and service performance remain unverified for this import. Qualify each target revision, model, backend and workload separately.
